title: Hunts FH-028: Define partner agreement and scope

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 3, Collective. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Define acceptance, terms, hours, staffing, data roles, fallback and exit responsibilities. Done when: A real operator can explain who owns claims, prize stock, cancellations and support per venue. Requires: FH-004, FH-027. Owner role: Partnerships.
